payload <- jsonlite::fromJSON("report-data.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
source("report-view.R")
job <- trimws(readLines("report-job.txt", warn = FALSE))
if (length(job) != 1L) stop("Expected one saved job key")
report_result_view(job, payload$result, payload$record)
